LiHua appreciates seeing her portrayed not only as a wise leader but also as a formidable warrior, highlighting her multifaceted nature and adding a sense of depth to her character. This response is drawn from the conversation between LiHua and EmilyBurnett, where both discuss their favorite characters and character development within the series.
